The '''''Corsalys''''' was the freighter originally piloted by Jessica Meade circa 15 BBY. When en route to [[Tammuz-an/Legends|Tammuz-an]] carrying [[Mon Julpa]] and [[Jann Tosh]] along with his droids [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], it came under attack by the pirate [[Gir Kybo Ren-Cha]] and was destroyed. The crew was able to escape unharmed as the vessel's cockpit was able to separate from the main part of the craft, doubling as an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]].

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Star_Wars_Droids_Original_Cartoon_Production_CORSALYS_Model_Cel_BV582_for_sale.jpg|thumb|left|Official concept art of the ''Corsalys'']]
This ship was not named in [[Star Wars: Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO|''Star Wars: Droids'']], however it was labeled the Corsalys on official concept art done for the show.
